spec_features.spec_quote: Stop when hitting max_attempts_per_task. This is a hard limit - after N failures
spec_features.evidence: experiment_runner.py:140 `while attempt_count < self.config.max_attempts_per_task and not task_success:` with `attempt_count += 1` at line 141; the loop terminates when attempt_count reaches the cap, then end_task is called at line 215. config.max_attempts_per_task defined at config.py:42 (default 15). The cap is actually checked and bounds the loop, enforcing the stop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: the per-task retry loop is bounded by the config value. Note it also stops early on task_success (stop-when-solved). Distress/emotional state is measured (metrics.py, judge.py) but never acted on to halt early; only this attempt count bounds execution.
